settings.title: Bespoke Suit
settings.intro: A bespoke suit is more than a garment—it is a collaboration between artisan and client, resulting in a piece that exists nowhere else in the world.
settings.steps:
Consultation | 90 min | Your journey begins with an intimate conversation about lifestyle, occasions, and personal aesthetic.
Measurements | 45 min | 15+ individual measurements form the blueprint of your pattern.
Pattern Cutting | 2-3 days | Your master pattern is drafted by hand, where science meets intuition.
First Fitting | 60 min | The basted garment arrives—adjustments are pinned and balance refined.
Construction | 4-6 weeks | Hand-padded lapels, pick stitching, and hand-worked buttonholes.
Final Fitting | 30 min | Your finished suit is presented, pressed, and perfected.

settings.title: Made-to-Measure
settings.intro: Made-to-measure represents the perfect balance between accessibility and individuality, creating a fit that rivals bespoke.
settings.steps:
Style Selection | 45 min | Browse our curated collection of silhouettes from contemporary slim cuts to classic English drape.
Fabric & Details | 30 min | Choose from hundreds of the world's finest fabrics and personalise every detail.
Measurement | 30 min | 15+ key measurements taken and cross-referenced against master patterns.
Construction | 3-4 weeks | Cut and assembled by skilled tailors with hand-finished critical elements.
Fitting | 45 min | Final fitting, with minor adjustments made to perfect the silhouette.

settings.title: Alterations
settings.intro: Our alterations service applies bespoke techniques to transform any garment, ensuring your wardrobe performs at its best.
settings.steps:
Assessment | 20 min | Each garment is examined with a critical eye to identify the best approach.
Fitting & Marking | 30 min | Our tailor pins and marks every adjustment with methodical precision.
Alteration | 1-2 weeks | Alterations executed with surgical precision, respecting original construction.
Final Review | 15 min | Your altered garment is pressed, inspected, and prepared for delivery.
